newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt c-bank to offer 500 mln pound repo Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Egypt c-bank to offer 500 mln pound repo Wednesday.

text.p: The Central Bank of Egypt will offer banks 500 million pounds ($147 million) of repurchase agreements on Wednesday when repurchase agreements of the same amount matures, private-sector bankers said on Tuesday.
They said the new repurchase agreements, like the previous one, have a two-week maturity.
Sources in the banking sector said the old offer was covered, but private-sector banks had avoided it altogether.
Bankers said the Central Bank was trying to keep the market liquid and ensure interest rates on the pound remained low.
